target.title: fix(channels): honor empty catalog docs prefixes
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where external channel catalog entries that intentionally set `selectionDocsPrefix: ""` were treated as if no prefix was configured. That caused channel selection/setup surfaces to fall back to the default docs prefix instead of honoring the plugin catalog metadata.

## Why This Change Was Made

The channel catalog, installed-package registry, and setup-note display paths all need to distinguish an omitted prefix from an explicitly defined empty prefix. The PR now preserves `selectionDocsPrefix` exactly at the manifest/catalog boundary, keeps explicit empty strings when hydrating persisted installed-package metadata, and sanitizes/trims only at the terminal display boundary without reintroducing the default prefix.

This keeps whitespace and empty-string metadata as plugin-owned catalog data while still preventing unsanitized text from reaching setup/status output.

## User Impact

Workspace and external catalog channel plugins can intentionally omit the docs prefix in selection/setup metadata. Existing catalog entries without `selectionDocsPrefix` still get the existing default prefix.

## Evidence

- Rebased on latest `upstream/main` at `0b9c2e6f95`.
- `OPENCLAW_HEAVY_CHECK_LOCK_SCOPE=worktree node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/plugins/manifest-registry-installed.test.ts src/flows/channel-setup.status.test.ts src/channels/plugins/catalog.test.ts -- --reporter=verbose`
  - `src/flows/channel-setup.status.test.ts`: 13 passed, including explicit empty prefix through setup selection notes.
  - `src/plugins/manifest-registry-installed.test.ts`: 19 passed, including package.json metadata and persisted installed-index metadata preserving `selectionDocsPrefix: ""`.
  - `src/channels/plugins/catalog.test.ts`: 4 passed, including empty-prefix preservation and non-trimming of non-empty prefixes.
- `pnpm format:check src/channels/plugins/channel-meta.ts src/channels/plugins/catalog.ts src/channels/plugins/catalog.test.ts src/plugins/manifest-registry-installed.ts src/plugins/manifest-registry-installed.test.ts src/flows/channel-setup.status.ts src/flows/channel-setup.status.test.ts`
- `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD`
- Claude structured autoreview on the rebased branch reported no accepted/actionable findings.

## Proof

- `src/channels/plugins/channel-meta.ts` no longer trims manifest-provided `selectionDocsPrefix`, so catalog metadata keeps defined-string semantics.
- `src/plugins/manifest-registry-installed.ts` preserves explicit empty prefixes when reconstructing package channel metadata from the installed index.
- `src/flows/channel-setup.status.ts` sanitizes defined prefixes at the setup display boundary while preserving `""` as defined, preventing the default docs prefix from returning.
- Regression tests cover the external catalog path, package.json metadata path, persisted installed-index path, and setup selection-note path.
